d.s: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a flexible water-based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a versatile multi-use product that is fast drying and can be applied by brush, roller, trowel or airless spray equipment on horizontal and vertical surfaces.

sec.t: 12 months from date of manufacture in original, sealed containers, if the storage conditions are met.
Store in dry, weatherproof environment, protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.
Minimum 1mm DFT (Dry film thickness) required 3x coats of 0.65 Litre per m2 are required to achieve a 1mm DFT

Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be applied to the following substrates: ▪ Concrete ▪ Masonry ▪ Sand/cement screeds ▪ Fibrous cement sheeting ▪ Compressed fibrous cement sheeting ▪ Steel/Aluminium ▪ Timber posts
Allow minimum 2 - 4 hours between coats at 23°C. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions. Drying time is dependent on ambient temperature and relative humidity.
1.0mm DFT- (Dry Film thickness): 7.5m2 per 15L pail 2m2 per 4L pail

All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. The substrate surface must be continuous, all projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be mixed with sand and cement or pre-bagged mortar mix to form a screed to falls or patching render with improved adhesion and tensile properties. Sheeting Fibrous cement sheeting must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation directions. Concrete Concrete must be allowed to cure for 28 days and cement render and sand and cement screeds must be allowed to cure for 7 days prior to the application. Surfaces must be even and smooth, imperfections repaired with a suitable Sika MonoTop repair mortar. Metals Metal surfaces shall be thoroughly cleaned and free of dust, existing coatings, contaminants and any signs of oxidation or rust must be removed before application of Ormonoid Bitkote No.3. Priming Dry porous substrates must be primed using a dilute 1 part Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 to 1 part water, work well into the substrate to ensure adequate penetration, avoid ponding. Allow to dry prior to general application. If moisture is present, allow for application of Sikalastic Moisture Seal, refer to PDS for application rates.
Single component, ready to use undiluted, prior to application thoroughly mix using a mechanical mixer to produce a homogenous liquid.
Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with water while the material is still wet. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not designed to stop a hydrostatic head of water pressure.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not suitable for use in immersed or tanking applications.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be used over damp, wet or contaminated substrates.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be applied if it is raining or if rain is imminent.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be applied directly over protective coatings.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be used as a trafficable coating.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not compatible with polyurethane or silicone sealants.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: For retaining walls allow a minimum of 3 days cure and suitable protection layer prior to backfilling.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Do not apply where the substrate temperature is below 10°C or greater than 35°C.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
